feature: Authoritative scheduling transactions, cost resources, and earned value

flows.name: Authoritative task mutation
steps: Open the authenticated production table workspace
Create a temporary task by pressing Enter in the quick-add row
Reload and verify the task persists at the requested anchor
Delete the temporary task and verify removal
flows.expectedOutcome: The task mutation is durable, ordered, reload-safe, and leaves no temporary record after cleanup.

flows.name: Cost resource and earned value
steps: Create a temporary equipment resource with an explicit rate
Assign it to the temporary task with planned and actual cost facts
Verify the cost table and earned-value metrics
Reload and verify the facts persist
Remove the assignment and resource through confirmation boundaries
flows.expectedOutcome: Rate and assignment facts persist and drive visible BAC, PV, EV, AC, CV, SV, CPI, and SPI output.

flows.name: Stale cost writer
steps: Advance the same resource cost version with a second authenticated request
flows.expectedOutcome: The stale mutation returns a conflict and the UI displays an actionable error without overwriting newer data.

claims.description: Task, dependency, cascade, and sibling-order writers use the authoritative lock and exact snapshots.
Equipment and material cost facts persist and produce visible earned-value metrics.
Stale scheduling and cost writes fail loudly without overwriting current state.
The exact published commit is Ready, aliased, and authenticated on the production route.
